title: Beef chow fun
intro: Beef chow fun is a Cantonese stir-fry built on wide, flat rice noodles cooked over fierce heat until they pick up patches of char, tossed with tender beef and bean sprouts in a dark soy sauce. It's valued for the smoky flavour that only comes from a very hot pan and noodles that are folded rather than stirred, so they stay intact.
